Each clip shows its own frames. A 30 fps clip in a 60 fps export shows every frame twice, so motion can look a little stepped.
The new in-between frames mix the two nearest frames like a quick cross-fade. Fast to export; fast motion can look ghosted.
The app follows how each part of the picture moves and draws real in-between frames. Smoothest motion, but the export is slower and very fast motion can smear at the edges.
